MY LITTLE PET · TEJA PRIYAN

Privacy policy

This policy covers the My Little Pet website, Windows game and mobile web app provided by Teja Priyan. Contact teja1616150@gmail.com with privacy questions.

Your game stays on your device

Owner and pet names, progress, settings, household and layouts are saved locally in Windows app data or your browser’s local storage. You can use a nickname. The mobile app caches its artwork and code for offline use. These game saves are not sent to a developer account or cloud sync service.

Website and download information

Hosting and distribution services such as GitHub Pages and itch.io process ordinary request information, including IP addresses and browser details, under their own policies. itch.io may provide aggregate page views and download counts. A download request does not prove an installation or a unique player. This website does not currently add its own analytics tracker or advertising cookies.

Support and optional donations

If you email support, your email address and the information you choose to send are used to help with your request. Avoid sending sensitive personal documents. Buy Me a Coffee opens a separate service which handles any optional contribution and associated information under its own privacy policy. My Little Pet does not collect card details or process payments in the game.

Your choices

Export a mobile save before clearing site data. You can remove local game data through your browser settings or the Windows save folder. Ask by email to delete support correspondence; some information may need to be retained for legal obligations. Third-party services control their own records.

Children and device permissions

No account or real identity is required to play. The game does not request access to your camera, microphone, contacts or location. A parent or guardian should handle support correspondence and optional contributions for a child.

Updated 29 October 2026.
